statement: Producer targeted checks for the production subtract-binary-batch oracle pass five controls: 12900 first-witness comparisons against general pair enumeration; 880 comparisons at degrees 11,17,31 with preparation reuse; 90 OpenSSL-backed full-point comparisons; whole-pipeline known-answer recovery; and failure/extra-lane accounting. The actual production library and ic CLI release checks pass. Broader suites and canonical test wiring remain separately tracked. No wall-time frontier, overall speedup, or independent signed verification is claimed.
